testimonials.text: I really appreciated the way this course was designed. The content was clear, well-structured, and easy to follow. I particularly enjoyed the section on polyps, as it was a topic where I had many knowledge gaps. Thanks to this course, I now have a much better understanding of this subject and have strengthened my knowledge.

The most interesting aspects of this course were the practical parts and real-life examples. I especially enjoyed case-based discussions, as they helped me understand the material more deeply. Learning about new and modern approaches in the field was also very engaging and useful.
This course has really helped me in knowing the causes and as I will be seeing and transferring patients I will have an understanding of what is going on with my patients.
